title: IDPAction file (data/idp/<year>.md)
$comment: One file per year, named by the year its actions were created (e.g. data/idp/2026.md), holding multiple actions in a single frontmatter list. If an action's target_date extends into a later year, it stays in its original file -- no migration between files; the filename reflects when the goal was set, not when it's due. The Markdown body (if used) is freeform notes and is not validated here. Informal/lightweight for MVP -- not enforced yet, just a shared reference for the Skill and dashboard parser.

year.description: The year this file represents (matches the filename) -- when the actions in it were created/set, not necessarily when they're due.

actions.description: All IDPAction entries created during this year.

id.description: Unique identifier, e.g. "idp-2026-001" (year matches the file it lives in). Referenced by OneOnOne.linked_actions and PerformanceEval.growth_areas.

title.description: Short description of the development goal, e.g. "Lead a cross-team migration project".

start_date.description: When work on this action began, YYYY-MM-DD.

target_date.description: Goal completion date, YYYY-MM-DD. May fall in a later year than the file itself -- the action still stays in its original (creation-year) file. Business rule (enforced later): must be on/after start_date.

linked_evidence.description: Free-text, date-prefixed entries demonstrating progress, e.g. "[2026-07-04] Manager confirmed intent to assign Q3 migration lead role". Not strict IDs -- referential integrity is Post-MVP.

source.description: Optional origin of this action, e.g. a 1:1 or performance evaluation ID it was first raised in (e.g. "1on1-2026-06-15" or "eval-2026-annual").
